prompt:
Redesign this app mark to survive 16 pixels. Same subject (speech bubble with text lines turning into a sound waveform) and same palette (#F8F8F9 bubble outline, #21F299 lines and waveform, #010616 backdrop), but rebuild the geometry around a chunky near-square silhouette: a bubble with a short thick tail, at most two thick text lines, and a waveform of three thick bars that reads as a single shape. Generous internal negative space, stroke weight about one eighth of the mark width. Flat, geometric, no gradients, no fine detail.

Reject and redo rather than include: no letters, no words, no pseudo-text, no gradients, no photorealism, no glowing orbs, no outline-and-drop-shadow logo cliches, no third element beyond the bubble and the waveform.
